senses.gloss: f. (חָּלַשׁ) tearing up, plucking; being detached, loose.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 9:1:5">Y. Sabb. IX, 11ᵈ</cite> bot.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 3:6:5">Y. Ab. Zar. III, 43ᵇ</cite> top <he>בית היתה לו שעת ת׳ וכ׳</he> a building has had a time when its material was loose, a cave has never had such a time.

<cite ref="Shabbat 73b:7">Sabb. 73ᵇ</cite> <he>אין דרך ת׳ בכך</he> this is not the ordinary way of plucking (dates). Y. ib. VII, 10ᶜ top <he>תְּלִישָׁתָהּ היא גיזתה</he> plucking it is in this case a form of shearing.
